$comment: AArch64 inline-assembly spellings GNU as and clang accept, which DSS refused at the P68 round-7 base (D-ASM-DIALECT-GAPS-A-REFERENCE-ASSEMBLER-ACCEPTS): the W-form `add`/`sub` immediates (and the form past imm12), operand placeholders as a memory base with and without an offset, and `cbz`/`cbnz` to a C label through `asm goto`, in both directions and at both widths. Each template has its own exit code (11–18, listed in `main.c`). ✔MEASURED 2026-09-21: aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 run it to 42 at -O0 and -O2 under qemu-aarch64. ★ The `release` arm: every input comes from a `volatile`, so the optimized pipeline keeps each template's operands and each branch real.
